description: This Java abstract class 'BodyDTO' provides serialization and deserialization logic for various 'Body' types in the mockserver project, including methods to create DTOs from Body objects, convert DTOs to strings, and manage optionality and type information.

classes.name: BodyDTO
classes.description: An abstract Data Transfer Object class for serializing various 'Body' types in mockserver, providing methods for creating DTOs from Body objects, converting to string, and managing optionality.

methods.name: createDTO
methods.description: Creates a specific BodyDTO subclass instance based on the runtime type of the provided Body object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes a BodyDTO instance into its string representation, handling different BodyDTO subclasses.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the Body.

methods.name: getOptional
methods.description: Returns whether the body is optional.

methods.name: withOptional
methods.description: Sets the optional flag for the BodyDTO.

methods.name: buildObject
methods.description: Abstract method to build the actual Body object from the DTO.
